runtimeAttestation.$comment: Phase 3B.1-R2. The identity of the TCLK runtime this lab EXECUTES, not merely the commit it was cut from. Phase 3B.1-R proved dist/ was a reproducible build of the pin and the promoted runtime still could not load: dist/transcript.js imports @scure/base and no production dependency closure had been promoted. Runtime identity is therefore the conjunction of source SHA + lockfile SHA + dist tree SHA + production dependency closure SHA + an entrypoint that actually imports. Verified by lab/runtime-attest.mjs; enforced by lab/upstream.mjs. Content-addressed evidence only: no node_modules and no dependency bytes are tracked in git.

generators: scripts/generate-frame-fields.mjs -> src/frame-fields.generated.ts (committed at the pin; `pnpm check:protocol` verifies the checked-in file matches the generator, so the build is not generator-order dependent)
build.note: Two independent clean clones of the pin, installed and built in isolation, produced the identical dist tree digest below.

productionDependencyClosure.lifecycleScriptReview: No package in the production closure declares preinstall/install/postinstall, and none needs one: @noble/curves, @noble/hashes and @scure/base are pure-JS, prebuilt, zero-dependency packages with no native component. --ignore-scripts is therefore an assertion of an audited fact, not a blanket suppression. The attested package's own prepublishOnly (pnpm build) is a publish hook and is never an install hook.

requiredBy.@scure/base: dist/transcript.js -> bare `import '@scure/base'` (base64url of canonical transcript bytes); root `dependencies` edge of @flop-labs/tclk. Its absence was the Phase 3B.1-R BLOCKED_RUNTIME_UNLOADABLE finding.

runtimeImport.note: A floor, not the full exported surface: pinning every name would make an upstream addition indistinguishable from a compromise. Checked AFTER import, because a module that loads but is not the protocol must also be refused.

staleArtifactIncident.$comment: Preserved, not overwritten. The originally promoted dist was a different artifact from an earlier commit; the repaired attestation is additive and this record keeps the incident falsifiable.
staleArtifactIncident.negativeControl: blackbox/tests/phase3b1r2.test.mjs asserts this tree is REFUSED against the reviewed identity above
